reports.title: Concentra Announces Results For Its Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2026

guidance.heading: 2026 Business Outlook
section: Concentra raised its financial guidance for 2026. We now expect to deliver the following results:
•Revenue in the range of $2.360 billion to $2.380 billion
•Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $505 million to $510 million
•Free Cash Flow in the range of $220 million to $240 million
•Capital expenditures in the range of $70 million to $80 million(1)
(1) Excluding acquisitions, and net of proceeds from sale of assets.
